notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
1. New motorcycle controls are complete

2. UI interaction system redesigned

3. The project has been redesigned to ensure extensibility

notes.title: Release and update is coming
notes.notes:
We were able to make a release on schedule. The product is still at a very early stage, we will take into account all your feedback


In the update we are preparing a new, simpler track. The existing one will also be expanded to normal sizes. 

Do not forget to look into the driving guide before starting the game :) http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32003339/52438b5b814672b11537e37f690140698e2dc781.png
